question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Subtle
solution:
The correct answer is: "**Exquisite**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Subtle**" means delicate or understated. (कोमल)
 
• "**Exquisite**" means extremely beautiful, delicate, or finely crafted, often to the point of perfection. (उत्कृष्ट) 
 
 
• **Example**: *The subtle design of the dress made it look exquisite.*
 
 

Hence, **option 3** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**Corrupt**", means dishonest or immoral. (बेईमान)
 
• "**Homely**", means plain or unattractive. (सादा)
 
• "**Wrong**", means incorrect or mistaken. (गलत)
